description: This file defines a unit testing class 'InvokeCommandRegistryTest' for the 'InvokeCommandRegistry' component of the AI OpenClaw Android application. It contains tests to verify command and capability advertisement based on different feature flags, as well as command lookup functionality.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for 'InvokeCommandRegistry', testing capabilities and commands advertisement, and command retrieval based on runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Tests that advertised capabilities respect the feature availability flags, including core and optional capabilities.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesFeatureCapabilitiesWhenEnabled
methods.description: Tests that optional capabilities are included when their corresponding features are enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Verifies that advertised commands match features enabled, excluding debug commands when not enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_includesFeatureCommandsWhenEnabled
methods.description: Verifies inclusion of feature-specific commands when their enabling flags are set.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_onlyIncludesSupportedMotionCommands
methods.description: Checks that only supported motion commands are advertised based on flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_splitsSmsSendAndSearchAvailability
methods.description: Ensures the correct advertisement of SMS commands based on send and search capabilities.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includeSmsWhenEitherSmsPathIsAvailable
methods.description: Asserts SMS capability is advertised when either read or send SMS is available.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Tests that call log commands are excluded when the call log feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures call log capabilities are not advertised when feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesVoiceWakeWithoutAdvertisingCommands
methods.description: Checks that VOICE_WAKE capability is included but voice commands are not advertised unless commands are enabled.

methods.name: find_returnsForegroundMetadataForCameraCommands
methods.description: Tests the command lookup function for specific commands, verifying foreground requirement flags.

methods.name: find_returnsNullForUnknownCommand
methods.description: Verifies command lookup returns null for unknown commands.
